classifiedFinding.title: setPauser accepts address(0) without validation, silently disabling pause/unpause capability

classification.assetImpact: Emergency-pause capability silently lost until owner reassigns. No external attacker path; admin misconfiguration only.
attackPath: 1. Owner deploys with default-empty config var resolving to address(0) or fat-fingers a 0x0 address.
2. pause() / unpause() become unreachable until owner notices and re-sets pauser.
3. A separately-discovered vulnerability that requires emergency pause cannot be mitigated until pauser is corrected.

classifiedFinding.justification: Low. Input-validation gap with no external-attacker path. Recommendation: require(newPauser != address(0)) or document zero as an explicit 'pause disabled' state.
